pages.title: Player commands (no permission needed)
text: /rpg info [player] - level, total experience, experience into the current level, experience for the next level, available points.
/rpg stats [player] - the full machine-readable snapshot, one key=value per line (see the next page).
/rpg list [player] - every one of the 26 lines with its invested points and current line value.
/rpg spend <line> <amount> - allocate points; a negative amount refunds, range -100..100.
/rpg discovery [player] - first-time reward progress per source.

pages.title: What /rpg stats prints
text: Level and points: level, total_xp, xp_into_level, xp_for_next_level, earned_points, spent_points, unspent_points, respec_count.

The 13 stats: stat.<stat>.computed (calculated value including equipment), stat.<stat>.effective (what the attribute actually holds) and stat.<stat>.clamped (whether the value was truncated - by the vanilla attribute range or by one of this mod's functional caps, such as 100% crit chance, 1.0 knockback resistance or the 90% damage reduction ceiling); plus attr.<vanilla attribute name>.

pages.title: Debug and admin commands (permission level 2)
text: /rpg debug addpoints <player> <n> - add or remove available points.
/rpg debug setlevel <player> <n> - set the level directly.
/rpg debug override <player> <stat> <value> - force a stat to a fixed value; use clear instead of <value> to remove it; /rpg debug override list [player] shows active overrides.
/rpg debug forcecrit <player> <true|false> - force every hit to crit, for testing.
/rpg admin setlevel <player> <level>, /rpg admin addxp <player> <amount>, /rpg admin setpoints <player> <line> <points>, /rpg admin reset <player> - direct admin writes and a full reset.
A line name is <stat>.<flat|percent>, for example attack_damage.flat or crit_chance.percent.
